preamble: Voicing of the voiceless alveolo-palatal affricate [tɕ] to its voiced counterpart [dʑ] keeps place and manner and adds vocal-fold vibration in a voiced environment. Korean voices lax /tɕ/ (ㅈ) to [dʑ] between sonorants; Standard Mandarin voices unaspirated j [tɕ] at the start of a weak syllable; and Polish ć [tɕ] becomes [dʑ] by regressive voicing assimilation before a voiced obstruent, as in pięćdziesiąt 'fifty'.

examples.note: The lax stops and affricate /p, t, tɕ, k/ are voiced [b, d, dʑ, ɡ] between sonorants and voiceless elsewhere.
Intervocalic ㅈ is realized as voiced [dʑ].
An unaspirated obstruent at the start of a weak (unstressed) syllable is commonly voiced, so j [tɕ] is realized [dʑ].
Final ć is voiced to [dʑ] by regressive voicing assimilation before the voiced affricate dź; the Middle Polish pronunciation shows the voiced [dʑ] before the cluster simplified.
